findings: Marked linked heading visibly retains bold/italic and its hierarchy; right heading and centered/right paragraphs remain aligned through typing and Undo.
Native marked-heading Shift Enter adds the visible line break while existing letters retain formatting; exact saved Undo restores the source.
Literal LF marked paragraph renders two lines through native edits and exact saved Undo.
Normal and narrow long titles wrap within the pane; lower content scrolls naturally, code/table remain intact.
Startup/loading frames are retained; clean restart restores the acknowledged document.
limits: Disposable profile, no provider turn or navigation activation
Clean Electron restart, not power loss or database death
Full video retained; sampled review is not every source video frame
